description: Payment failed, is stuck pending, or money was deducted but the order/service was not created. Diagnoses from operator-observed gateway status; never charges or refunds automatically.

facts.name: transaction_ref
facts.description: Transaction ID or payment reference number (never a full card number)

facts.name: payment_status
facts.description: Operator-observed status in the payment gateway or admin dashboard

facts.name: payment_completed
facts.description: Whether the payment has now completed successfully for the user

facts.name: order_created
facts.description: Operator-observed: whether the order/service exists for this payment

steps.instruction: Ask the user for the transaction ID or payment reference number. Never ask for full card details.
Check the payment status for this reference in the payment gateway or admin dashboard.
Tell the user the payment is still pending: wait 10 minutes and do not retry yet. Then ask whether the payment has completed.
Tell the user the payment failed and no money should have been taken. Ask them to retry the payment once and confirm whether it succeeded.
The payment succeeded. Check whether the order/service was created for this payment.
Document the transaction reference, gateway status, order status and timestamps for the escalation.
